headline_stat.name: % POST ripples with significant sequential replay

stated_limitation: We restrict analysis to the track interior [0.1, 1.5] m: the extreme boundary bins are contaminated by reward-consumption / turnaround firing that otherwise swamps the interior place fields and pins the decoder to the track ends.

justification.dataset: 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1, sub-Achilles) is the canonical linear-track replay dataset, an expert's first choice.
justification.handling: Real ~9 GB NWB streamed via remfile, excitatory CA1 units, correct PRE/Maze/POST epochs, velocity-thresholded runs, and a defensible single ripple-band LFP channel selected by power.
justification.analysis: Standard Bayesian decoder validated on running (20 cm error), weighted-correlation sequence scoring, and a circular-shift place-field shuffle whose null correctly takes the max over both directional templates.
justification.correctness: Reported numbers reproduce and are internally consistent (700/3467 = 20.2%, median span 111 cm ≈ 1.1 m, 20 cm decoder error), rest on thousands of events, and the p<0.05 score distribution is cleanly right-shifted from n.s.
justification.figures: Every figure is readable with units and sample sizes; place-field diagonal, on-diagonal confusion matrix, textbook ripple, and diagonal posterior sweeps with matching rasters make the effect obvious.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and examples are labeled as examples and ranked by effect strength, but the write-up states only the interior-restriction rationale and single session without a dedicated limitations discussion, placing a genuinely clean result at 3.
justification.verdict: A validated, well-controlled replay pipeline yielding a clean, internally consistent fourfold enrichment over chance; accept as-is.
